integrity: Proof uses Newton identities, Jacobian/complete-intersection reducedness, explicit local normalization, and the polynomial logarithm. Exact finite field code is a finite verification, not the proof of infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: This is the coefficientwise power-sum flat complete-intersection model, not an assertion of semistable or stable reduction or the Neron model.
Six nonnodal branches at one point; no claim about smooth model or other integral equations.
Historical priority qualified: implicit deductions in older Bring--Jerrard or regular-sequence literature remain possible.
title: Six rational branches and an additive Picard group in the characteristic-five Bring model
